title: Pre-solicitation: Oil/water mixture and contaminated sand/soil from oil/water separators at Osan Air Base
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-OO.411TH CSB.0906 AQ CO     CONTRACTING BAT
description_text: THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION(SYNOPSIS) NOTICE FOR COMMERCIAL SERVICE ABOUT OIL/WATER MIXTURE AND CONTAMINATED SAND/SOIL FROM OIL/WATER SEPARATORS AT OSAN AIR BASE, REPUBLIC OF KOREA IN ACCORDANCE WITH FAR PART 5.2. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTE/PROPOSAL OR INVITATION FOR BID. THE GOVERNMENT WILL NOT RESPOND TO INQUIRIES RESULTING FROM THIS PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE. THE DETAIL INFOMRATION ARE PROVIDED IN THE ATTACHED SYNOPSIS AND PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT.
